nX01.text:
X01 Make searchable (OCR)
Adds an invisible text layer to scanned pages; page images stay untouched. Opens in Edit mode (it changes the file).
States: options (local engine), server chosen → consent block naming the pages sent, in progress with per-page review, low-confidence words, done (toast + 1 unsaved change), engine not installed, cancelled. Signed sample file: the §7.13 note.
Todos: E13c, E13d

nX02.text:
X02 Convert to and from PDF
Office/HTML → PDF and PDF → Word/Excel as a job. On web every conversion is a server job, so the dialog asks for explicit consent before any byte is uploaded. Web page → PDF sends only the address and names both hosts.
States: consent (upload button off until ticked), uploading, converting, ready, deleted from server, failed.
Todos: E13f, E13g, E13e

nX03.text:
X03 Revision browser
Timeline of incremental updates; opens any earlier revision read-only.
States: one revision only (empty), revision open read-only (banner), signed revision markers, damaged chain.
Todos: E14b

nX04.text:
X04 Compare two versions
Side by side with synced scroll, or overlay with pixel diff; a changes list (text, annotations, pages) links to each change.
States: choosing files, comparing (progress), no differences, page count differs, report exported.
Todos: E14c

nX05.text:
X05 Batch runner
Applies a saved recipe (steps with selectors) to many files; per-file results with warnings.
States: empty queue, running, finished with warnings/failures, server batch on web (consent listing every file and the total size; depends on full-editor §9 Q3).
Todos: E14d, E14e

nX06.text:
X06 Accessibility checker
Matterhorn machine checks and font/Unicode checks, grouped, each linked to the page and with a fix action where safe.
States: not run, checking, issues, all machine checks pass (with ‘manual checks remain’).
Todos: E15d

nX07.text:
X07 Tags and reading order
Tag tree in the rail, numbered reading-order overlay on the page, alt text and tag type in the inspector.
States: untagged file (start tagging), editing, drag vs ‘Move up/down’, artifact.
Todos: E15b, E15c

nX08.text:
X08 Save as PDF/UA or PDF/A
Runs the profile’s checks, shows what will be added, then saves a copy; refuses with a report when checks fail.
States: checking, pass, fail (report, fix links), saved.
Todos: E15e, E16e

nX09.text:
X09 Optimise
Save an optimised copy: images, fonts, unused objects, object streams, linearise; size estimate before saving.
States: estimating, estimate ready, signed file conflict, saved with before/after report.
Todos: E16b, E16c

nX10.text:
X10 Print production
Preflight report (rules as data), output intent, separations and overprint preview; imposition dialog with live sheet preview.
States: preflight running, issues, pass; imposition N-up and booklet.
Todos: E16d, E16e, E16f

nX11.text:
X11 Layers and actions
Layers rail panel (show/hide is view-only; edit, lock, default state are file changes). Actions tool (Edit › Tools ▾ › Actions); JavaScript is kept as text: “This file contains JavaScript. lamina never runs it.” (ADR 0021 pending); recognised scripts are handled natively.
States: no layers (panel hidden), locked layer, JavaScript note.
Todos: E17c, E17b

nX12.text:
X12 Measurement and media
Measure tool (distance, perimeter, area) honouring the page scale; media and 3D show posters with a play/unsupported notice.
States: scale from file vs set by user, calibrate, video playing, 3D not supported.
Todos: E17e, E17d, E17f
